text: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS games_played FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY total_points DESC, player_name ASC LIMIT 10
